mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth above 1.5% indicates economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth rate below 0.5% indicates slowing labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 signals contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
